name: com.stitchpunk.dotsanimationtoolkit
description: DOTS-native animation toolkit for Unity Entities: 2.5D cutout transform tracks, flipbook sprite animation, and bone/vertex animation textures (VAT), with blob-baked clip registries, Burst-compiled sampling, and a full editor clip pipeline. Pre-release: 0.8.0 adds playback, layer compositing and crossfades, animation events, bounds and LOD, VAT texture baking, standalone HLSL shader components, a UI Toolkit clip editor with live preview, socket attachment points, and asset inspectors. Sockets, the clip preview and the VAT runtime-mesh step are new and not yet battle-tested. Remaining before 1.0: multi-source VAT tracks, and PlayMode integration coverage of the socket and preview paths.

samples.description: Generates a complete working actor - rig, clip set, an animated clip, and a prefab wired to bake - through the same public API you would use yourself.
